must_not: reopen a closed episode without new explicit gates
start C06 or M3.02 from an episode-closure record
resolve carried threads merely because the episode ended

outputs: player-facing scene only through current operational gate
must: load source and authorized hidden preparation before scene
respect player action and actual dice
stop if cycle or permission is absent
require a separately valid scene and explicit Narrator authorization; episode closure grants neither

must_not_receive: NPC-only information absent a played reveal

must: acquire only through observation, statement, or accessible evidence
retain uncertainty when source is insufficient

AGENT_KNOWLEDGE.disclosure_rule: Use only for the declared audience; NPC action requires that individual’s acquired knowledge.

PLAYER_KNOWLEDGE.disclosure_rule: Use only for the declared audience; NPC action requires that individual’s acquired knowledge.

PC_KNOWLEDGE.disclosure_rule: Use only for the declared audience; NPC action requires that individual’s acquired knowledge.

NPC_KNOWLEDGE.disclosure_rule: Use only for the declared audience; NPC action requires that individual’s acquired knowledge.

global_rules: No player-facing prompt/report contains hidden plot content.
Planned NPC actions/events are not canon or played facts until actually played and persisted.
No automatic scene readiness, narrator permission, XP, or state transition.
GM_HIDDEN/SECRET/HIDDEN constrain disclosure to the player, not authorized agent access.
No cycle transition or scene permission is inferred from authoring or validation artifacts; use the exact active cycle and its validator.
emergency_flow: If canon conflict, required retcon, indispensable source unavailable, impossible mechanics, or true access failure arises, pause only the affected branch; finish independent work and record a player-safe administrative blocker.

validation_behavior.unknown: Preserve historical unknowns unless an explicit currently admitted source and authorized variant resolve them.
validation_behavior.failure: Preserve actual failure. If recoverable, keep the route pending/quiet or use a supported causal alternative; only actual irreversible outcomes or explicit player choices may close it.
validation_behavior.refusal: Respect refusal. Do not count pre-start refusal as a completed story, force an incomplete outcome, or reissue an offer automatically; any later action needs an admissible cause and valid offer.
validation_behavior.early_discovery: Reveal only what an authorized source supports through play.
validation_behavior.abandonment: No automatic retaliation, new event, or infinite hook.
validation_behavior.contract_reference_validation: Resolve Markdown anchors and JSON pointers before adversarial tests pass; evaluate each criterion and declared reducer assertion.
validation_behavior.episodic_closure: Close only the finite episode at the approved checkpoint; carry all open threads and current state unchanged; keep route disposition independent.
